info.title: VoxNexus HTTP API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API for a VoxNexus instance. Probe routes `/health`, `/ready`, and `/metrics` are not part of this document.

post.summary: Log in with email and password.
Clear the session cookie and delete the server session.

get.summary: Current account for the session cookie.

patch.summary: Change email (re-auth; applied immediately until F117 adds confirmation mail).

401.description: Wrong current password or not authenticated

post.summary: Change password (re-auth with current password).

401.description: Wrong current password or not authenticated

get.summary: OIDC provider callback: exchange code, resolve account, set session cookie, redirect home.

200.description: HTML bounce to SPA with session cookie

302.description: Redirect to login on provider/login error

get.summary: Redirect the browser to the configured OIDC provider (authorization code + PKCE).

post.summary: Register a local account and set the session cookie.
Archive a channel (hide from default lists).
Clone channel shell (no messages).

get.summary: List permission overrides for a channel.

put.summary: Upsert a member override on a channel.
Upsert a role override on a channel.

post.summary: Restore an archived channel.

get.summary: List communities the caller belongs to.

post.summary: Create a community when instance policy allows.

get.summary: List categories in a community scope (`space_id` query = Space; omit for community-level).

post.summary: Create a category (owner / manage_channels until F029).
Reorder categories in a scope by id list (owner).

get.summary: List channels in a community scope.

post.summary: Create a channel (owner / manage_channels until F029).
Reorder channels in a scope by id list (owner).
Delete a community (owner only, typed name confirm).

get.summary: List active (non-revoked) invites for a community.

post.summary: Create an invite (owner / manage_invites — owner until F029).
Join an open community.
Leave a community (owners cannot leave until transfer exists).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor: members after this account id

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor: members before this account id

patch.summary: Update the caller's nickname in a community.

get.summary: List roles assigned to a member.

post.summary: Assign a role to a member.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a member.

post.summary: Create a role group.
Bulk move roles into a group (or ungroup).
Create a custom role.
Reorder custom roles (owner / role managers).

get.summary: List Spaces visible to the caller in a community.

post.summary: Create a Space in a community (owner / manage_spaces — owner until F029).
Transfer community ownership to an existing member (owner only).
Accept an invite by code.
Upload avatar image (raw body; Content-Type ignored in favor of magic bytes).
Upload banner image.

get.summary: Instance name, version, and public policy flags.
List accounts currently online on this instance (invisible omitted).

delete.summary: Delete a role group (roles become ungrouped).

post.summary: Clone a role shell.
Upload a custom role icon (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP).

get.summary: Get one Space (404 if restricted and not a member).

post.summary: Join an open space (community members). Restricted spaces require an admin add.
Leave a space.

404.description: Not a member or not found

get.summary: List members of a space (space members or community owner).

post.summary: Add a community member to a space (owner until F029).

delete.summary: Remove a member from a space (owner until F029).

AccountResponse.description: Public account fields (never includes password hash).

AddSpaceMemberRequest.description: Add a community member to a space (restricted / manual).

AssignRoleRequest.description: Assign a role to a member.

BulkAssignRoleGroupRequest.description: Bulk assign roles to a group (or ungroup when `group_id` is null).

ChangeEmailRequest.description: Change email (requires current password; applied immediately until F117 adds confirmation mail).

revoke_other_sessions.description: When true, delete all other sessions for this account (current session stays).

ChannelType.description: Channel type registry (F027). Typed features attach in later milestones.

CommunityCreationMode.description: Who may create communities on this instance.

CommunityListResponse.description: List wrapper for communities the caller belongs to.

CommunityMemberResponse.description: One community member with profile display fields.

CreateCategoryRequest.description: Create a category in a community (optionally scoped to a Space).

CreateChannelRequest.description: Create a channel in a community scope.

oneOf.description: Relative expiry from creation time. Omit for no expiry.

CreateSpaceRequest.description: Create a Space in a community.

DeleteCommunityRequest.description: Confirm community deletion by typing the community name (F025).

ErrorBody.description: JSON error envelope for `/api/v1` and unknown routes.

InstanceSettingsResponse.description: Instance settings visible to instance admins.

InviteExpireAfter.description: Relative invite lifetime chosen before code generation.

InviteListResponse.description: List of invites for a community.

InvitePreviewResponse.description: Preview for join-by-code UI (no sensitive creator detail beyond community).

JoinMode.description: How accounts may join a community (invites/applications expand in later features).

MetaResponse.description: Build, version, and public instance policy flags for the SPA.

oidc_enabled.description: Whether SSO sign-in is configured and enabled for this instance.

password_login_enabled.description: Whether email/password login and registration are offered.

PermissionOverrideListResponse.description: Overrides for a channel (includes category-scoped rows when applicable).

PresenceListResponse.description: Online users visible on this instance.

PresenceStatus.description: Stored preference and gateway-reported status while connected.

PublicPresenceStatus.description: Presence exposed to clients (offline when disconnected or hidden from viewers).

RegisterRequest.description: Register with email, password, and display name.

RegistrationMode.description: Who may register new local accounts on this instance.

ReorderCategoriesRequest.description: Reorder categories by sending new positions in order.

ReorderChannelsRequest.description: Reorder channels in a scope by id list.

ReorderRolesRequest.description: Reorder roles by id list (display `position` only; does not change weight).

SpaceListResponse.description: Spaces in a community, ordered by position.

SpaceMemberResponse.description: One space member with profile display fields.

is_member.description: Whether the caller is a member of this space.

SpaceVisibility.description: Who can see / enter a Space (F023 membership expands access rules).

TransferCommunityRequest.description: Transfer community ownership to another member (F025).

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: Update a category (name, position, or scope).

UpdateInstanceSettingsRequest.description: Partial update of instance settings (instance admin only).

UpdateNicknameRequest.description: Update the caller's nickname in a community.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Patch display name, bio, presence, and/or custom status.

display_name.description: Empty string is allowed (new accounts start blank until set).

clear_group.description: When true, remove the role from its group.

clear_icon_emoji.description: Set true to clear icon emoji.

UpsertPermissionOverrideRequest.description: Upsert a role or member override on a channel.
